# UMass Computer Science - People Directory

> Faculty and student profiles, research interests, and course materials for the University of Massachusetts Amherst Computer Science Department.

This directory provides access to academic homepages, research profiles, and educational resources for computer science researchers and instructors at UMass Amherst. The site covers diverse areas including AI security, cybersecurity, embedded systems, and quantum networking research.

## Key Topics

- AI Security
- Cybersecurity
- ARM v7 Architecture
- Embedded Systems
- Quantum Networks
- Machine Learning
- Assembly Language
- Microcontroller Programming
- Computer Architecture
- Deep Learning Systems
- Software Engineering
- Resource Allocation
- Pathfinding Optimization
- UMass Amherst
- CICS

## Faculty Research & Profiles

- [Shiqing Ma - Academic Homepage](https://people.cs.umass.edu/~shiqingma/): Faculty profile specializing in AI security and cybersecurity research at UMass, including work with the UMass AI Security and Cybersecurity initiatives

## Graduate Research & Student Profiles

- [Quantum Networks & Resource Allocation Research](https://people.cs.umass.edu/~shahrooz/): PhD student profile focused on quantum networks and resource allocation research at CICS
- [Pathfinding & Optimization Research](https://people.cs.umass.edu/~mengxuezhang/): Academic profile highlighting pathfinding simulation and optimization research projects

## Course Materials & Educational Resources

- [CmpSci 335: ARM v7 Architecture & Embedded Systems](https://people.cs.umass.edu/~weems/homepage/courses/cmpsci-335.html): Course materials covering ARM v7 architecture, microcontroller programming, and embedded systems fundamentals
